benchmark.scope: Known complete complex waveform, channel, transmitted bit, alignment and white proper-complex noise variance. Fixed-path Gaussian presence-detection NP benchmark at the same per-test alpha allocation; not achieved receiver performance, bit-error probability, authentication, acquisition, full-system optimum or a duration guarantee. No waveform energy supplied to receiver.

limitations: Only16 independent signal paths per validation cell; methods and SNR alternatives reuse those paths. Same seeds across changed physical cases need not imply identical samples.
Pointwise one-sided Clopper-Pearson endpoints assume independent equal-probability Bernoulli trials within the stated cell; they are not simultaneous intervals across this selected grid.
Original six failed executions remain separate from repaired source-variant results. Microwave phase-loss tolerance0.02dB is a distinct approximation arm; all other cells retain0.01dB.
Compact report package omits raw physical statistics. Receipts and available JSON/NPZ hashes are checked; raw content hashes are retained from source-bound receipts, not independently re-read here.
